title: Security-Enhanced Seed-Based Weight Quantization for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) incur substantial storage, memory-bandwidth and energy costs, motivating compact weight representations. Existing seed-based compression methods reconstruct weights from compact pseudo-random representations but do not explicitly account for the non-uniform sensitivity of model weights. We introduce Seed-Q, a security-enhanced sensitivity-aware seed-based weight compression framework that uses lightweight Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR)-based weight generation with non-uniform bit allocation. Our approach assigns larger representation budgets to sensitive weights while aggressively compressing less sensitive regions. Importantly, this non-uniform allocation requires no side-information: the decoder deterministically reconstructs the bit-allocation schedule, with no rung depending on the decoded weights, eliminating the need to store per-block metadata or use calibration data while preserving the basel

translated_title: 面向大语言模型的安全增强型基于种子的权重量化方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.38477v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）带来巨大的存储、内存带宽和能耗成本，这推动了对紧凑权重表示的研究。现有的基于种子的压缩方法可以从紧凑的伪随机表示中重建权重，但并未显式考虑模型权重的非均匀敏感性。我们提出了Seed-Q，一个安全增强的、敏感性感知的基于种子的权重压缩框架，该框架使用基于线性反馈移位寄存器（LFSR）的轻量级权重生成与非均匀比特分配。我们的方法为敏感权重分配更大的表示预算，同时对不太敏感的区域进行激进压缩。重要的是，这种非均匀分配不需要任何附加信息：解码器可以确定性地重建比特分配方案，任何层级都不依赖于解码后的权重，从而无需存储逐块元数据或使用校准数据，同时保持基线（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Seed-Q框架，利用LFSR种子生成与非均匀比特分配实现大语言模型权重的敏感性感知压缩，为敏感权重分配更多比特且无需附加信息、元数据存储或校准数据。
en_tdlr: Seed-Q is a security-enhanced sensitivity-aware seed-based weight compression framework for LLMs that uses LFSR-based weight generation with non-uniform bit allocation, assigning larger representation budgets to sensitive weights while requiring no side-information, per-block metadata, or calibration data.
